name: Brutalist Web (2014)
summary: Browser-default type, blue underlined links, grey or white ground, no polish and visible structure. It came from the 2014 Brutalist Websites collection and answers the smooth, templated web.

philosophy.core_thesis: A page is a document, not a product: show the raw structure and the web serves the reader without decoration.
design_principles: Use the browser default: black text on white (#FFFFFF) or grey (#C0C0C0), links #0000EE, visited links #551A8B, underlined.
Set body text in a default serif or a monospace at 16px with a 1.3 to 1.5 line height and a measure above 80 characters or full width.
Build the layout from plain blocks: tables, lists and rules of 1px to 2px; no more than 2 columns.
Use a single heading size jump of 2x: 16px body and 32px headings, in bold, no tracking.
Show structure: visible borders of 1px, a hard 2px rule between sections and raw URLs in text.
Make every interactive element a native control: default button, default input, default checkbox, 0 custom styling beyond a 1px border.
Use no more than 2 colours plus link blue, and no transitions.
anti_patterns: Custom web fonts beyond one monospace or serif
Hero sections with a stock photograph
Smooth scroll effects and entrance animations
Card layouts with equal tiles and padding above 24px

layout.grid_mechanics: A single flow of blocks and tables with no declared grid; at most 2 columns made from a table or float, and a max width of 100% of the viewport.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% of the surface stays empty; spacing is 8px and 16px only, close to the browser default.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left; no centring except a full-width title; elements stack in source order.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px radius and a 1px solid black border; tables and horizontal rules separate content.

font_pairings.note: A metric match to Times New Roman, the browser default.
A monospace that gives the page a raw, terminal feel.
A typewriter display with a serif text face.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set headings in the same face as body.
Show links by underline and blue only.

color.palette_structure: White or grey, black text and default blue links; one loud colour may fill a block.
color.contrast_rules: Black on white holds 21:1; link blue on white holds 8.6:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque, no texture; the default white or grey of the browser.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source and no shadow on any element.

materiality.surface_simulation: Raw HTML: the page does not imitate any material.
materiality.border_rules: 1px solid black on tables and boxes; 2px rules between sections.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. Shadow is none on every element.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Icons are replaced by text labels; if one is needed, use a 1px-stroke square pictogram.
ornamentation_details.illustration: None; use a single plain image with no frame, or ASCII art.

motion.transition_physics: No motion; state changes are immediate with 0ms transition.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover keeps the default pointer and underline; active state shows the default red (#EE0000) link.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels honesty and friction: the page does not try to sell.

avoid_when: The product needs trust through polish.
The audience expects a smooth, branded commerce flow.
The page needs rich imagery or video.

modifiers.how: Add a 12-column grid, one neo-grotesque face and generous space; keep the 1px rules.
Add 3px borders, hard shadows and one saturated colour block.
Break the alignment, overlap blocks and mix 3 faces.

pack.why: A thin square line with butt terminals; the thinnest family that still reads as a plain pictogram.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none border border-black bg-[#C0C0C0] px-3 py-1 text-base text-black
